# Murmie

> **Just say it. Murmie types it.** Murmie is free, private, on-device voice dictation for macOS. Double-tap Right Command, speak, and your words are typed wherever your cursor is. Speech is transcribed on the Mac. The app has no accounts, servers, analytics or tracking.

Made by SHUUL Technologies LLP.

## Product notes

- **Platform**: macOS 26 or later, Apple silicon only.
- **Price**: free. Proprietary freeware; not open source.
- **Transcription**: on-device. Speech engines include Google Gemma, WhisperKit, NVIDIA Parakeet and Apple's speech engine. Models download from Hugging Face on first setup.
- **Privacy**: audio never leaves the Mac. Optional AI features (AI correction, Ask AI, meeting summaries) can use a cloud AI service with the user's own API key; they are off by default. The app checks GitHub for updates about once a day; this can be turned off in Settings. The website (murmie.com) uses Microsoft Clarity for visitor analytics.
- **Hotkeys**: double-tap Right Command to start dictating, tap Right Command to finish and paste at the cursor, Esc to cancel, or hold Right Option for push-to-talk (optional).
- **Install**: download the DMG from the home page, or run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shuul-io/murmie-releases/main/install.sh | bash` in Terminal.
